resources.string: A dynamic island for every Android
Draws the island above the status bar and lock screen; screenshot, lock and recents tiles.

Enhanced mode lets Lagoon draw its island above the status bar and on the lock screen, so the whole pill responds to taps, and lets the island\'s tiles take a screenshot, lock the screen or open recent apps when you tap them. It only receives the name of the app in front, so the island can follow your per-app settings. It never reads, records or acts on anything shown on your screen, it cannot perform gestures for you, and nothing leaves your phone: Lagoon has no internet permission. You can switch it off here at any time.
